learning_outcomes:
Gerontology 1. Major Programme: Graduates from the
Programme will have acquired the ability to: Knowledge domain Describe the
fundamental concepts in chronic disease management, aged care services
design including psychological and societal perspectives of ageing Explain the
theoretical models and frameworks related to care in gerontology and
hospice care plans Describe the
fundamental knowledge of epidemiology and biostatistics, infectious
disease control in aged care services Skill domain Optimise policies
and financing strategies for aged care Coordinate aged
services to improve efficiency Utilize evidence
based approach to inquire, analyze and criticize contemporary public
health issues Strengthen the
infection control capacity of aged service facilities Steer quality aged
service innovation Strengthen
communications among practitioners, and provide high-quality and
individualised services Value domain Demonstrate respect for cultural
diversity and sensitivity Demonstrate dedication to sustainable
development Demonstrate care for social equity and
justice Demonstrate understanding on ethical
issues in ageing and end-of-life care
